note: Weekdays are 0 (Monday) to 6 (Sunday). Times are venue-local wall-clock times in the calendar's time zone. A session's trading date is the local date on which it closes. The TRADFI_EXAMPLE_* calendars are illustrative structures only: their times were NOT verified against any exchange or broker publication, they carry no holiday or early-close data, and they are UNVERIFIED, so the market availability guard refuses them for order submission.

calendars.source: Platform convention, not an exchange publication: the platform has always treated crypto perpetual markets as continuously open (app/symbols/market_hours.py returns open for CRYPTO_PERP / CRYPTO_SPOT) and builds daily bars on the UTC day. Venue maintenance and outages are handled by the exchange adapters, not by this calendar.
calendars.description: Crypto perpetuals: always open; the daily bar is the UTC day.

calendars.source: Illustrative example written for Step 7.2; modelled on the general shape of an electronic futures week (overnight sessions with a daily break). NOT verified against any exchange publication. No holidays or early closes populated.
calendars.description: Example: Sunday to Thursday 17:00 open, next day 16:00 close, one-hour daily break between sessions.

calendars.source: Illustrative example written for Step 7.2; modelled on the general OTC FX convention of a week from Sunday 17:00 to Friday 17:00 New York time with a daily rollover at 17:00. NOT verified against any broker publication. No holidays populated.
calendars.description: Example: five contiguous sessions, Sunday 17:00 to Friday 17:00 New York time, each closing at the 17:00 rollover.

calendars.source: Illustrative example written for Step 7.2; a weekday day session. NOT verified against any exchange publication. No holidays or early closes populated.
calendars.description: Example: Monday to Friday 09:30 to 16:00 New York time.
